name: Bauru

queries.query: Bauru Brazil official cadastral parcel map geospatial GIS municipal parcel service
queries.result: Found the official Prefeitura Municipal de Bauru geoprocessing page. It links to the municipal Geopixel Cidades viewer and states that the geoprocessing/georeferencing system is a municipal system under Contrato 10.935/22. The separate official digital-maps page also publishes a 2024 cadastral map PDF and directs users to the current geoprocessing platform.

queries.query: Bauru cadastro imobiliário mapa cadastral geoprocessamento prefeitura parcelas lotes
queries.result: Found the official municipal geoprocessing page, the official digital cadastral-map page, and municipal land-subdivision/project procedures. The public pages evidence municipal cadastral/geoprocessing custody, but no openly documented parcel REST endpoint or anonymous parcel geometry response was exposed by the viewer checks.

registryBasis: A first-party Prefeitura Municipal de Bauru page identifies and links the municipal geoprocessing/georeferencing system, and the official SEPLAN page publishes a cadastral digital map and points to the current platform. This establishes a local municipal GIS/cadastral custodian, not an accessible parcel API or proof of citywide parcel completeness.

officialSources.observation: Official Prefeitura Municipal de Bauru page; identifies the municipal geoprocessing/georeferencing system and links to the live Geopixel Cidades viewer.
Linked public viewer. Its current configuration file points to the Bauru-specific server at https://bauru.geopixel.com.br/geopixelcidades3_server.
Official SEPLAN digital-maps page; lists a cadastral/zoneing/commercial-corridor map PDF and directs users to the geoprocessing platform for current data.
Official municipal page for land-subdivision projects/maps; access is procedural and the page does not provide an anonymous parcel feature service.
